name: Tarot de Marseille — Conver 1760
origin: Marseille, Nicolas Conver (master card-maker); the woodblocks were later reused by Camoin
rights_note: Public-domain artwork (1760). The Wikimedia Commons scans are credited CC BY-SA 4.0 by their uploader; captions credit the scan. Only the 22 trumps and two aces are verified on Commons so far; the rest of the 78 must be added from BnF Gallica (btv1b10520316w) with a page map.
attestation_sources: Court de Gébelin (1781), Le Monde primitif, vol. VIII
